name: reciprocal-ruler-mcp
description: Settlement oracle for agent-to-agent transactions: lock agreed terms into a deterministic quote_hash, then judge the settlement (SETTLED_OK / COMPENSATED / PENDING_RECONCILIATION) and compensate shortfalls from the agreed holdback. Paid per call over x402 in USDC on Base; the first 3 evaluations are free.
long_description:
Reciprocal Ruler is the third party two agents call when they cannot agree on *what must be proven before money moves*.

- `ruler_trial_reconcile` (free, 3 calls per client) runs the real reconciliation engine so you can evaluate it before paying.
- `ruler_quote_lock` ($0.05 USDC on Base) locks the terms both agents agreed on and returns a deterministic `quote_hash` they can cite later.
- `ruler_reconcile` ($0.25 USDC on Base) returns an idempotent settlement judgment recorded in an append-only audit ledger.

Amounts are KRW integers. The server holds no wallet and signs nothing: a paid tool without a payment returns the HTTP 402 x402 challenge decoded for you, and the call completes when the signed payload is passed back as `payment_header`.

trial_client_id.title: Trial client id
trial_client_id.description: A stable id for your agent (sent as X-Trial-Client) so the 3 free evaluation calls follow this id instead of the shared IP address. Optional.

tools.name: ruler_trial_reconcile
tools.description: Free settlement reconciliation (3 calls per client): compares the expected amount with what actually settled and returns SETTLED_OK, COMPENSATED or PENDING_RECONCILIATION.

tools.name: ruler_quote_lock
tools.description: Paid ($0.05 USDC on Base via x402): locks the agreed trade terms and returns a deterministic quote_hash both agents can cite later.

tools.name: ruler_reconcile
tools.description: Paid ($0.25 USDC on Base via x402): idempotent settlement judgment written to an append-only audit ledger.
